subject: [PATCH 18/46] mm/khugepaged: check if PTE table is empty in try_collapse_pte_mapped_thp()

reviews.author: Gregory Price
reviews.summary: Identified potential issues with the patch's locking mechanism, suggesting a simpler approach. However, later acknowledged that the original code is actually correct and elegant.
reviews.raw_body:
On 2026-10-29 12:01 +0100, David Hildenbrand (Arm) wrote:
> On 10/29/26 02:48, Gregory Price wrote:
> > On 2026-10-27 00:17 +0100, David Hildenbrand (Arm) wrote:
> > 
> > I get that you want to avoid taking both locks while zapping, but
> > wouldn't it be simpler?  I suppose we don't know what kind of
> > regressions might pop up with that though, bah.
> 
> Exactly, that's the spirit of the original code. We would just block a 1GiB
> range of va space for the entire operation.
> 
> If you think there is a more elegant way of doing it (while minimizing holding
> the pmd lock), please shoot :)
> 

Elegant and this code do not appear to be compatible.

Another look, i think this is the preferred route.

Reviewed-by: Gregory Price (Meta) <gourry@gourry.net>

-- 
Gregory Price (Meta) <gourry@gourry.net>

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Defended the original code, explaining that it correctly handles potential deadlocks and is in line with the spirit of the original implementation.

2026-10-29.patch_summary: A patch to improve the handling of PTE tables in khugepaged, specifically checking if the table is empty before collapsing THPs.
